description: This file defines the 'NoneOf' validation rule class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically as part of the API version 2 validator composite rules. It extends an abstract composite class and specifies the use of the respect/validation library's 'NoneOf' rule.

classes.name: NoneOf
classes.description: A validation rule class that extends AbstractComposite and defines a 'NoneOf' rule using the respect/validation library.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the underlying validation rule, which is 'Rules\NoneOf' from the respect/validation library.
